description: Get the next food license renewal deadline. Give a Florida DBPR license_number for its real expiry date, or a state (plus optional city and business_type) for states/cities with a verified fixed yearly deadline (e.g. Michigan Apr 30). Returns null with guidance when there is no verified fixed date (e.g. anniversary-based permits, or Ohio food trucks, which renew before first operating in the new licensing year).
name: next_renewal_date
title: Next food license renewal date
